title: Kestrel Limited Warranty — Coverage Term and Covered Systems by Vehicle Program
content:
Every order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements includes a Kestrel limited warranty. Its length and the systems it covers depend on the vehicle program.

| Vehicle program | Coverage days from the handover date | Coverage miles added to the handover odometer | Days after the failure date for the facility to request authorization |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 30 | 1000 | 30 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 100 | 4189 | 30 |
| Kestrel Certified | 150 | 6000 | 30 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 180 | 7500 | 30 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 365 | 12000 | 30 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 100 | 4189 | 30 |

**Covered systems.**

| Vehicle program | Systems covered |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | engine, transmission, drive axle |
| Kestrel Inspected | engine, transmission, drive axle, cooling system, fuel system, electrical, air conditioning, steering, brakes, suspension |
| Kestrel Certified | the ten Kestrel Inspected systems plus transfer case and seals and gaskets |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | the twelve Kestrel Certified systems plus hybrid and EV drive system and high-tech electronics |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | the same fourteen systems as Kestrel Certified Plus |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | the same twelve systems as Kestrel Certified |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle handed over on day 0 at 20000 miles is covered until day 180 or 27500 miles, whichever comes first.
